note: [L] assigns weights one to three through Banjo.Promise (graded Maps parts) and, in Heir.Seed.four, removes every weight-one slot by the gauge-fixing projection so survivors have weight at least two. The difference: [L] states this as vanishing of jets in gauge-fixed coordinates rather than as a radial-gauge expansion with commutators of constant parts.

proof_context.conclusion: Promise d C r splits a direction as a sum of d+1 parts w i of size C*r^(i+1), the first d lying in Maps o X (i+1).

intro m a v hA
  by_cases hV : ∃ i, a i ≤ 1
  · obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hV
    have hv : π (v i) = 0 := Prod.ext rfl (funext fun j => ((hA.1 i).2.2 j (by omega)))
    have hm : m ≤ 4 := le_trans (by simpa using Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (f:=fun _ => 1) (fun j _ => (hA.1 j).1)) hA.2
    rw [(hP.iteratedFDeriv (𝕜:=ℝ) m).eq_of_nhds,jets_linear π (hD.of_le (show (m:ℕ∞ω) ≤ 4 by exact_mod_cast hm)),ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    exact ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_coord_zero _ i hv
  have hv (i) : 2 ≤ a i := by have h := not_exists.mp hV i; omega

proof_context.conclusion: A slot of weight at most 1 is killed by the gauge projection (F o q = (F o q) o pi, map_coord_zero), so every surviving slot has weight at least 2.
